'''Cemma the Younger''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] gunslinger from a backwater world. Although he had gained a reputation as a deadly quickdraw, in fact he preferred to shoot unsuspecting victims in the back rather than challenge them openly. Cemma had a handsome, youthful face which made him popular among [[Gender/Legends|women]] and which led most humans to believe that he was trustworthy. In fact, Cemma was little more than a ruthless, psychopathic murderer.

While on [[StarForge Station]] Cemma responded to a call by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Dhas Fenoep Vedij|Dhas Vedij]] to join the crew of the [[Rebel privateer]] vessel [[Far Orbit]].
